contentTree.heading: Colocated Marijuana Operations (CMOs)
contentTree.content:
An adult-use Marijuana Cultivator, Product Manufacturer or Retailer also be licensed as an
MTC as defined in to 935 CMR 501.002. No other adult-use license type qualifies to be a CMO.
Unless otherwise specified, a CMO shall comply with the requirements of each of the adult-use
and medical-use license located on the Premises of the CMO.
